clues: This is a city in the southwest part of Gyeonggi Province in South Korea. It sits in the west of the country, in East Asia.
This place has the warmest January and the hottest August in its whole province. It also gets the least rain there, since hills lift less moist air here.
This city began in 1940, when two districts joined to make one new place. That union is the start of its story as a single city.
In the Korean War, this city saw one of the first fights of the war. United States troops clashed here with troops from North Korea.
A big navy base of South Korea sits in this city. Lots of troops from the United States stay here too.
